interpretation: Scheme behaves as designed (first order in time, ~second order in space) but the reference grid/dt carry substantial numerical diffusion (K_eff about 1.6K). Synthetic verification only.
limitations: Fourier test uses uniform wind along x; open boundary analytic comparison is 1-D strip only; no real-data validation
what_failed: Nothing failed. Initial claim of +31% numerical diffusion was incomplete (reviewer: total +61% at dt=60 s, 50 grid)
what_happened: Verification script ran (RUN-0001, 1m42s): Fourier spatial error 0.155/0.061/0.024 at nx=20/40/80 (ratio ~2.55), time error halves differences with dt, dt-refinement RMSE change 1.76e-4 -> 9.2e-5 (first order), grid 50 vs 100 differs by 0.40% of max, budget residual <=1.9e-14 relative, quadrature ratios 1+9e-8 at worst
what_worked: Discrete symbol agreement ~1e-14 (unit tests); mass budget closes; no negative values; K_eff matches (Pe/2)coth(Pe/2)-1+u^2dt/2K within 3%

interpretation: In this idealised matched experiment (same solver and grid for truth and inference: inverse crime) the amplitudes are well identified. This says nothing about real data.
limitations: Single noise draw and single layout; matched model; Gaussian noise with known sigma; accurate fields do not by themselves establish attribution
next_experiment: Deployment comparison across layouts and cases
what_happened: Reference simulate (RUN-0002, 2.8 s solve; max budget residual 1.6e-14, 0 negatives) and inverse (RUN-0003, 2m21s incl. direct route). 5 sensors every 600 s, S5 held out, noise 0.005 ug/m3 (~3% of 0.161 peak). q_hat=[97531,146718,78807] vs true [1e5,1.5e5,8e4]: relative L2 error 2.2%; regional RMSE 9.7e-4 ug/m3; held-out sensor RMSE 4.3e-4; rank 3, effective rank 3, condition 5.6; direct (least_squares) and cached (lsq_linear) agree to 4e-9 relative
what_worked: Both routes agree; weighted residual 8.2 for 96 observations (expected ~9.6 if model and noise are right)

interpretation: Within this synthetic matched setting, designing for the regional error with design scenarios helps; the main driver is avoiding plume-blind layouts (identifiability), so much of the gap vs spread/random is about covering the plume corridor rather than fine optimisation. Greedy is not globally optimal (tiny-fixture exhaustive gap up to 3.7x was seen in tests) and does not win every case.
limitations: 6+6 scenarios, 3 noise reps: modest; sd is not a confidence interval; matched model shares solver/grid with truth (see mismatch); single wind-ensemble definition; alpha choice not tuned
what_failed: alpha=0 headline means are dominated by a few unidentifiable draws; weak prior alpha=1 was adopted AFTER seeing this, chosen a priori (not tuned) and the alpha=0 run is kept as sensitivity. greedy_weighted is not reliably better than greedy even on the population metric (budget 2 worse).
what_happened: RUN-0004 smoke (18 s); RUN-0005 benchmark alpha=1 (4m56s, peak mem ~176 MB; 6 design + 6 test scenarios, 3 noise reps, 20 random layouts/budget); RUN-0006 same with alpha=0 (4m46s). Alpha=1 uniform-weight mean test RMSE (ug/m3), budgets 1/2/3/5/8: greedy 0.019/0.0037/0.00089/0.00039/0.00036; spread 0.022/0.015/0.0086/0.0086/0.0018; random(mean of layouts) 0.035/0.024/0.018/0.0076/0.0037. Paired greedy-minus-spread mean diff -0.0035/-0.0116/-0.0077/-0.0082/-0.0014, greedy better in 78/100/83/94/94% of 18 pairs. Alpha=0: unregularised fits blow up for layouts blind to the plumes (random 1-sensor mean RMSE 2e19, spread 4.8); medians sane. Greedy at alpha=0 is stable (0.019/0.0057/0.0012/0.00047/0.00026).
what_worked: Greedy selected on design scenarios beat spread and random on the independent test scenarios on average at every budget; design-to-test gap small for greedy

interpretation: Hidden wind error and an unmodelled source dominate over discretisation mismatch in this setup; refined truth shows the matched benchmark was only mildly optimistic from the inverse-crime effect (~+0.0006 ug/m3 at budgets >=3). More sensors do not fix wind or missing-source error: the floor is set by the model error.
limitations: One magnitude per mismatch kind (+20% speed, 15 deg rotation, one extra source of 60000 ug/s at one location); weighted layouts not evaluated under mismatch; 6 scenarios x 3 reps; synthetic only
what_failed: Not every individual draw worsens under mismatch (frac_worse 0.78-1.0 for refined truth and 0.83 in some budgets), reported as observed.
what_happened: RUN-0007 (7m51s). Fixed design-stage layouts from results/benchmark on the regenerated 6 test scenarios x 3 noise reps. Greedy mean test RMSE (ug/m3) matched vs refined-truth vs wind-perturbed vs extra-source at budget 3: 0.0009 / 0.0015 / 0.018 / 0.011; at budget 8: 0.00036 / 0.0010 / 0.016 / 0.010. Poor corner layout (3 sensors): effective rank 0 in every case, condition inf or >1e8, singular values ~1e-9 or smaller; estimates collapse to the prior (source relative error ~1.0) while regional RMSE 0.03-0.08.

what_happened: RUN-0009 benchmark-final (2m35s) and RUN-0010 alpha=0 sensitivity (2m36s) on FRESH test scenarios (seed 33, noise 7000) with alpha=0.1 read from results/alpha-selection/alpha_selected.json (sha256 cd526c9d...). interpretation: The municipality polygon agrees with an independent mapped administrative boundary; the shortfall is in the coarse district outline, not the municipality. Rather than loosen the 90% threshold, the check was extended with documented independent evidence (relation polygon IoU>=0.9 AND hierarchy names the district AND no other district overlaps >1%); the raw ADM2 coverage stays in the manifest as an informational failed check. Re-run needed to record this in the manifest.
limitations: Interim synthesis; the IND ADM0 polygon is a generalised 2014 outline (mean 2082 vertices), so distances to the Indian side are coarse; Nepal ADM0 (66k vertices) is used for the border
next_experiment: Re-run fetch (cache hits + relation lookup) and prepare; then verify DEM/relief and finish geography docs
what_failed: First prepare could not mark the boundary verified (coarse ADM2 outline); the Overpass main endpoint was unreliable
what_happened: RUN-0014 and RUN-0015 (geo fetch) were cancelled: overpass-api.de refused connections / returned 504 for tiny queries (one backend of its DNS pool was down), so the OSM step stalled. Fix: bounded retries with backoff, a documented fallback endpoint (maps.mail.ru Overpass mirror), and OSM requests limited to the municipality + 2 km margin. RUN-0016 completed: geoBoundaries ADM0 NPL/IND, ADM2, ADM3 (commit-pinned 9469f09), Nominatim locator, OSM roads/buildings/landuse/amenities via the mirror, Copernicus GLO-30 DEM window, all with sha256 and licences. RUN-0018 (geo prepare, offline, 16 s) produced a manifest with boundary_status=approximate: name, shapeID, geometry validity, area (122.96 km2 vs 123), bbox, UTM EPSG 32644 and the independent Nominatim locator (OSM relation 5927493, admin_level 7, Kanchanpur district, Sudurpashchim, 0.0 km) all passed; the parent-district check failed because only 71.7% of the polygon lies inside the geoBoundaries ADM2 'Kanchanpur' polygon, which has just 36 vertices, with the remaining 28.3% inside no ADM2 polygon (no other district overlaps).
what_worked: Real boundary, DEM and OSM features acquired within bounded requests; independent comparison against the OSM administrative relation polygon (outside the run, scratch check): area 122.89 vs 122.96 km2, IoU 0.938, Hausdorff 238 m

interpretation: In this idealised linear setting the local/external split is recoverable when the sensitivity matrix is well conditioned and fails (flagged) when plumes arrive late or are collinear; whole-boundary inflow bases are a poor stand-in for a distant localised source. None of this identifies real emitters.
limitations: Synthetic matched model (same solver/grid for truth and inference except the labelled special cases); 4 validation + 6 test cases and 3 noise draws; one demonstration geometry with the external source 1 km from the domain-A boundary; sd is a standard deviation; the confounded default needed a 5 m/s wind, 3.8 km upwind geometry and a dedicated layout
next_experiment: Belauri geography forward runs and geographic design
what_failed: An upwind reference site at fixed budget is not a free win: it improves the boundary/external terms but costs interior coverage, so total and local error are larger than with eight interior sensors in this setup. Wind mismatch is not detected by any flag (see special/wind_mismatch.csv)
what_happened: RUN-0017 (26.5 min): all four sub-studies on domains A (20 km) and B (30 km). Scenario fields: study-region origin fractions local/external = 0.57/0.43 (explicit E1), 0.78/0.22 (uniform boundary input), 0.52/0.48 (mixed); no_arrival external-to-local ratio 4.1e-6 (verified by the forward model). Recovery from TOTAL observations, alpha selected on 4 validation cases (alpha=1 at both noise levels) then frozen, 6 test cases x 3 noise reps: with 2% noise the 8-interior layout recovers local/external emission amplitudes to 1.1%/0.6% (mean relative error) and the external concentration fraction to 0.0016; the 6-interior layout to 15%/0.8% and 0.015; 6 interior + 2 upwind reference sites 14%/0.4% and 0.015. At 10% noise: 8-interior 5.3%/2.8%, 6-interior 19%/3.9%, 6+2 upwind 24%/2.1%. Equal budget (8 sensors): interior8 beat interior+upwind on total RMSE (lower in 14 of 18 pairs at 2% noise), local RMSE (17 of 18) but interior+upwind was lower on external RMSE (10 of 18) and external amplitude error. Strong prior (alpha=1e5) destroys recovery (amplitude errors 0.7-0.99); alpha=0 is close to the selected alpha at 2% noise. Confounded case: column cosine 0.991 between L1 and the collinear external source, flags rank_deficient and confounded:L1,E1c, effective rank 2, condition 14.9; total-field error stays small relative to decomposition error. Boundary input vs a localised plume: omitting E1 gives 0.257 of the peak as RMSE, adding a uniform or four-sector boundary basis only 0.250 — whole-side boundary input cannot represent a localised plume. Domain A vs B: study-field difference 0.9% (external-only) and 3.3% (mixed) of peak.
what_worked: Identifiability flags fire for the confounded and no-arrival cases without a prior hiding them; noise is set relative to a documented signal scale; alpha frozen on validation before the test ensemble; raw rows saved

interpretation: Superseded by the rerun once fixes land
limitations: As in S1, plus the caveats above

what_failed: RUN-0017's boundary-basis equivalence result is invalid
what_happened: CORRECTION to S1 after the independent Opus review: the boundary-basis equivalence sub-study of RUN-0017 contained a coordinate bug (observation layout built in domain-A coordinates while the truth was sampled in domain B, whose study region is shifted by buffer_B-buffer_A), so most sensors read the wrong place and every fit returned L1=0. The statement 'whole-side boundary input cannot mimic a localised plume; 0.257 -> 0.250 of peak' is NOT supported and is withdrawn. On smoke settings with the layout corrected the reviewer found RMSE/peak 0.097 (local-only) vs 0.080 (uniform basis) vs 0.079 (four-side bases), i.e. the opposite direction. Also: the confounded diagnostics quoted in S1 (effective rank 2, rank_deficient) belong to the 30% noise level, not 2%; at 2% the only flag is confounded and the split is recovered; tangential faces were classified by floating-point round-off (v=1.2e-16), affecting the 90/180/270 degree rows of the wind sweep; the scale vector (1e5 µg/s, 0.05 µg/m3) acts as a prior width when alpha>0; the inversion is given the true temporal profiles. All other production numbers in S1 matched the CSVs. A fix worker and a clean-commit rerun (new run, variant experiment) are in progress; until then the recovery, domain-size and special-case tables stand with these caveats and the equivalence study does not.
what_worked: Review caught the defect before it entered any conclusion outside the repo

interpretation: Geography milestone met with one caveat: the polygon is geoBoundaries ADM3 (derived from government data) cross-checked against OSM, not an official survey-department file. Terrain: essentially flat in the simulated domain; the northern relief is >20 km beyond the municipality's northern edge, so terrain-driven flow is unresolved.
limitations: IND outline coarse; ADM0/ADM3 share lineage; OSM completeness unknown; DEM is a surface model; terrain dynamics not modelled
next_experiment: Belauri forward production and geographic sensor design

interpretation: On this flat region the wind direction, the outer-domain size under reversing wind, the mesh and the numerical diffusion matter far more than the nominal K; DEM layers are context only. All is synthetic: real geography with synthetic emissions and meteorology.
limitations: Numerical diffusion at 500 m is 2.5-5x the nominal K, so fine plume structure on this mesh is not resolved; the Courant number is reported per axis speed (oblique winds approximate); terrain-driven flow is unresolved (relief begins >20 km north of the polygon); synthetic winds only; one emission set
next_experiment: Geographic sensor design on the same region
what_happened: RUN-0025 (4m45s, clean commit f29f96b): four prescribed synthetic winds on the real Belauri grid (500 m, 66x65 cells, T=8 h), emissions road 1.5e6 / built-up 1.0e6 / external patch 5e5 µg/s (external onset 2 h; synthetic). Tags sum to the direct combined solve to 3e-15 relative; budget residual <=1.9e-14; no negative values. Combined study-region peaks 0.261-0.395 µg/m3; external fraction 0.22 (WSW), 7e-5 (north), 2e-4 (east), 0.05 (reversal), 0.19 (channelled demo). The external patch reaches the polygon only under WSW (nearest polygon cell 789 s after onset, nearest facility 2020 s, centroid 2627 s; the far cells are not reached in 8 h). Outer domain 2 km buffer vs 8 km: no change for steady winds, -10.5% in the study-region mean under the wind reversal (mass that left cannot return). Mesh: 500 m dt100 vs 250 m dt50: mean +1.0%, peak -3.3%, centroid arrival shifts up to 260 s; dt halving at 500 m changes the mean by 0.04 percentage points. Numerical diffusion estimate K_eff/K = 4.9 (500 m, dt 100), 4.3 (500 m, dt 50), 2.5 (250 m, dt 50) against nominal K=100 m2/s; doubling K changes the regional mean by 0.15%. Plotting-only layers (DEM, hillshade, slope, profile) change no number (replacing them by constants gives exactly 0.0 change).
what_worked: Conservation and tag-sum checks; plotting-only check exact; every comparison saved with provenance

interpretation: Whole-side boundary bases capture part (22-34%) of the study-region error caused by a localised external plume but leave most of it; the benefit depends on the assumed temporal profile; omitting an external source biases local amplitudes, so a pure local-only fit would misattribute.
limitations: Only whole-side and four-side bases tested; synthetic matched model; 4+6 cases; sd is a standard deviation; known temporal profiles; the confounded example is constructed (5 m/s, 3.8 km, dedicated layout)
what_failed: No identifiability flag detects a wrong wind; strong prior can lower error under a wrong model (shrinks to zero) which must not be read as better inference
what_happened: RUN-0024 (27.8 min; code revision b270276 whose transboundary-relevant sources are identical to HEAD; provenance flags dirty because other workers edited unrelated files during the run: the recorded list is .research records, one design test, geodesign.py and the run's own outputs). Recovery, prior-sensitivity and domain-size numbers reproduce RUN-0017 (same seeds, alpha=1 selected on validation; 8 interior sensors recover local/external amplitudes to 1.1%/0.6% at 2% noise). CORRECTED boundary-basis equivalence (truth: E1 explicit in domain B; fitted models in domain A omit E1; sensors at the same study-relative sites): RMSE/peak 0.172 local-only, 0.118 uniform basis and 0.114 four-side bases with a basis onset matching E1, 0.135/0.133 with a mismatched onset (7200 s vs 3600 s), against 0.009 for E1 explicit; omitting E1 biases the local amplitudes upward (L1/L2 estimates 1.27e5/1.03e5 vs truth 1e5/0.7e5; 1.03e5/0.94e5 with a uniform basis). Scale sensitivity (interior8): inflow scale x0.1/x10 and emission scale x10 barely change results; emission scale x0.1 raises 10%-noise total RMSE from 0.00147 to 0.00737 and external amplitude error from 0.028 to 0.34, so the scale acts as a prior width. Confounded: 2% noise flags [confounded] only (effective rank 3, amplitude errors 0.05/0.03); 30% noise flags [weakly_constrained, confounded] (effective rank 2, errors 0.32/0.21, F_ext error 0.11). No-arrival at alpha=0: E1 estimate 7.3e10 µg/s, total RMSE/peak 1.47, F_ext 0.39 vs 4e-6 true, flags unidentifiable:E1 and rank_deficient; with alpha=1 the estimate is ~0. Wind mismatch: total RMSE/peak 0.486, F_ext 0.212 vs 0.397, NO flag.
what_worked: The review's blocker is fixed and the corrected comparison is reported; tangential-face round-off fixed (wind sweep rows rerun); diagnostics per noise level

interpretation: In this synthetic setting a design-optimised layout helps most at 1-3 sensors and mainly through avoiding poor coverage (random is worst), while beyond 5 sensors differences are within noise; optimising the attribution objective is not harmful for total error at small budgets and helps there; the external reference site was not a clear win at equal budget. Results describe a numerically diffusive model (K_eff/K 2-15 at the design mesh) and are not a statement about field deployment.
limitations: 6+6+6 scenarios, 3 noise draws; sd is a standard deviation and cases are not independent of reps; matched model (robustness reported separately); synthetic emissions/meteorology; mapped accessibility is not permission/power/security/connectivity; Courant up to 0.49 at the highest design wind speed
next_experiment: Robustness and refinement study on the fixed layouts
what_failed: No method dominates: greedy_total did not beat spread on the total error at 1 sensor (mean +0.0075, 3/6 cases) and the 2-sensor win is small; selecting on the total objective on 6 design scenarios did not transfer reliably to 6 test scenarios at small budgets
what_happened: RUN-0026 (11.8 min, peak memory 354 MB): Belauri 500 m grid, inference parameters road/built-up (local), external patch, uniform inflow background; 6 design (seed 101), 6 validation (202), 6 test (303) scenarios with disjoint noise ranges; 3 noise reps; noise 5% and 15% of a documented signal scale; alpha=0.01 selected on VALIDATION cases at both noise levels and frozen before the test ensemble; 54 interior candidates (1.5 km lattice in the polygon) plus 47 domestic-reference sites (42 across-the-border hypothetical sites excluded by default). Interior-only, 5% noise, selected alpha, test ensemble, mean total regional RMSE (µg/m3) for budgets 1/2/3/5/8: greedy_total 0.0223/0.0093/0.00525/0.00353/0.00272; greedy_attribution 0.0105/0.0065/0.00542/0.0037/0.00327; spread 0.0148/0.0117/0.0058/0.00512/0.00323; random mean 0.025/0.0135/0.0103/0.00666/0.00328. Paired greedy_total minus spread (total RMSE): +0.0075/-0.0024/-0.0006/-0.0016/-0.0005 with greedy lower in 3/2/4/5/5 of 6 cases; greedy_attribution minus greedy_total: -0.0118/-0.0028/+0.0002/+0.0002/+0.0006 (greedy_attribution lower in 5/5/3/3/1 of 6 cases); on the attribution error greedy_attribution is lower at 1-2 sensors (0.132 vs 0.285, 0.087 vs 0.107) and about equal beyond. External-fraction absolute error at 8 sensors ~0.01 for all methods. Reference sites were rarely or never chosen by greedy at equal budget; with_reference vs interior_only differences are small. Random layouts are worse than greedy at 1-5 sensors in 5-6 of 6 cases.
what_worked: Constraints, role guards and alpha freeze held (tests); all raw rows, paired tables, candidate and layout GeoJSON/CSV saved with provenance; no infeasible budgets in the standard or block-holdout regimes

interpretation: At equal budget the external reference sites did not help total error; the attribution objective used them sparingly (1-2 sites) and gained a small improvement in attribution error at 8 sensors (0.0361 vs 0.0415)
what_happened: CORRECTION to S1 (checked against results/geodesign/layouts.csv and candidates.csv): the hypothetical across-border pool has 41 sites (not 42); the statement that reference sites were 'rarely or never chosen by greedy' is replaced by the exact facts: in the with_reference setting (<=2 domestic reference sites, counted in the budget) greedy_total chose NO reference site at any budget; greedy_attribution chose 1 at budget 5 and 2 at budget 8; spread (farthest-point) includes reference sites from 2 sensors up and is WORSE for it on the total error (0.0124/0.0083/0.0070 at budgets 2/3/5 vs 0.0117/0.0058/0.0051 interior-only); random layouts also include them. All other numbers in S1 stand.
what_worked: Self-check against files caught two unsupported phrases before they entered the docs

interpretation: Layouts are selected at a design noise level and alpha; their small-budget ranking is sensitive to the noise level on 6 test scenarios, so no small-budget method ordering is established; beyond 5 sensors differences are within noise at both levels
limitations: 6 test scenarios x 3 reps; sd is a standard deviation
what_happened: CORRECTION S3 (found by the documentation pass and verified in results/geodesign/summary.csv): the layout ranking depends on the noise level. At 5% noise (interior-only, selected alpha) greedy_attribution has the lowest total RMSE at 1-2 sensors (0.0105, 0.0065 vs greedy_total 0.0223, 0.0093). At 15% noise the order changes: total RMSE greedy_attribution 0.0625/0.0298/0.0212/0.0086/0.0079 vs greedy_total 0.0366/0.0174/0.0156/0.0108/0.00833 vs spread 0.0285/0.0214/0.0158/0.0116/0.0082 vs random 0.0422/0.0227/0.0182/0.0128/0.00826 for 1/2/3/5/8 sensors, i.e. greedy_attribution is the WORST of the four at 1-3 sensors (paired greedy_attribution minus greedy_total +0.026/+0.012/+0.006, lower in only 2/3/2 of 6 cases) and best at 5-8; its attribution error is also worse at 1-3 sensors at 15% (0.553/0.348/0.269 vs 0.436/0.226/0.189). The S1/F-013 statement that attribution-objective layouts are 'not worse on total error at small budgets' therefore holds at 5% noise only and is withdrawn as a general statement.
what_worked: Cross-check by a second pass caught an over-generalisation

interpretation: In this synthetic setting the dominant uncertainty for sensor-design conclusions is the meteorology the estimator is told, not the sensor count: an unknown 20%/15 degree wind error costs about an order of magnitude in total error at 3-8 sensors, far more than omitted sources or a profile error, and no diagnostic flags it. The 500 m layouts are properties of this numerically diffusive model and should not be read as sites.
limitations: One perturbation per condition; 6 test scenarios (3 fine); 3 noise reps; sd is a standard deviation; refinement re-selection uses 3 design cases; the refined truth uses the same scheme (lower bound on the inverse-crime effect); provenance records git_dirty (inverse.py capability check and docs edited during the run, outside the code path used)
next_experiment: Final scientific review of the geographic results
what_failed: Layout rankings do not survive hidden/unseen wind errors; site selection is not stable under mesh refinement (3 design cases only)
what_happened: RUN-0027 (compute 44.8 min by perf_counter, peak 375 MB; the run wrapper reports 3h17m wall, consistent with the laptop sleeping while idle — inferred, not observed). Fixed design-stage layouts from results/geodesign were re-evaluated on the regenerated test ensemble; matched rows reproduce the main test_raw (pairing check passed in-run). Interior-only, 5% noise, selected alpha, mean total RMSE (µg/m3) for greedy_total at budgets 1/2/3/5/8: matched 0.0223/0.0093/0.00525/0.00353/0.00272; hidden_wind_error (truth +20% speed, +15 deg, not told) 0.0436/0.0385/0.0442/0.0462/0.0312; unseen_wind (speeds 2.6-3.5 m/s, directions off the design sectors, nominal wind declared) 0.0446/0.0418/0.0412/0.0413/0.0294; unseen_wind_declared (same winds told to the estimator) 0.0174/0.0128/0.00467/0.0033/0.0028; omitted_facility 0.0303/0.017/0.0144/0.0156/0.0145; omitted_external 0.0233/0.0108/0.0071/0.00477/0.00409; boundary_time_profile 0.0221/0.00925/0.00547/0.00428/0.00361; refined_truth (250 m) 0.0245/0.011/0.00817/0.00805/0.00662. Same pattern for greedy_attribution and spread. Identifiability flags: identical to the matched rows in every condition (fraction equal 1) while the error grows ~10x under unknown wind errors, so flags do not detect a wrong model. Method rankings: the sign of the contrast between methods agrees with the matched sign in 100% of boundary_time_profile contrasts, 83-90% for omitted sources and refined truth, 45-50% for hidden/unseen wind (coin-flip). Numerical diffusion at the design mesh (500 m, dt 100): K_eff/K 2.4-9.1 over the drawn speeds (0.8-2.5 m/s), higher at the 3.5 m/s of the unseen winds. 250 m re-selection (3 design + 3 test fine cases, budgets 3 and 5): layouts overlap weakly with the 500 m layouts (Jaccard 0-0.2, mean nearest-site distance 1.4-4.6 km); greedy_total 250 m layouts have lower error on the fine test truth in 3/3 cases at budget 3 (0.00475 vs 0.00591), greedy_attribution 250 m layouts do not (1/3, 0.00994 vs 0.00622).
